run_crystal_structure_relaxation: run crystal structure relaxation on CIF files using UMA ML potentials via the CLI with a config YAML
create_calculator: create a FAIRChemCalculator with a pretrained UMA model for structure relaxation using the specified calculator config
get_relax_config_and_dir: get relaxation parameters and output directory path from a workflow configuration dictionary
relax_atoms: relax a single ASE Atoms crystal structure using BFGS, FIRE, or LBFGS with optional cell relaxation
relax_atoms_batch: relax multiple crystal structures in batch mode using FairChem's torch-based LBFGS optimizer on GPU
